Read: Niacinamide at 5% · Acne literacy

settings.heading: Do's
settings.content:
• Apply 2–3 drops on clean, dry skin after cleansing.
  • Use once daily; twice daily only if your skin tolerates it well.
  • Follow with moisturiser; add SPF in the morning.
  • Stay consistent for several weeks before judging results.
  • Patch test before first use if your skin is reactive.

settings.heading: Don'ts
settings.content:
• Don't layer immediately with strong AHAs, BHAs, or vitamin C if your skin is easily irritated.
  • Don't over-apply — more product won't speed results.
  • Don't skip moisturiser after the serum.
  • Don't use on broken or highly inflamed skin.
  • Don't expect overnight clearing; give the routine time.

settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Cleanse → apply 2–3 drops of serum and pat in → moisturise → protect with SPF in the morning. Introduce one new active at a time.

settings.question: Who is this serum for?
settings.answer: It's formulated for oily and acne-prone skin that needs oil balance, pore-focused care, and a lightweight treat step. If your barrier is very compromised, start slowly and moisturise well.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Many people with reactive skin tolerate niacinamide well, but always patch test first. Start every other day if your skin is easily irritated, and avoid stacking strong actives at the same time.

settings.question: How long until I notice a difference?
settings.answer: Oil balance and feel can improve within the first 1–2 weeks of consistent use. Texture and clarity usually need several weeks. Stay consistent and keep the rest of your routine simple.

settings.question: Can I use it with salicylic acid or vitamin C?
settings.answer: Yes, with planning. Use this serum on alternate nights from strong exfoliating acids if your skin is new to actives. Vitamin C is often better in the morning with SPF; keep niacinamide in your treat step once or twice daily as tolerated.

settings.question: Morning or night?
settings.answer: Both are fine. If you use it in the morning, always finish with broad-spectrum sunscreen. At night, follow with moisturiser.

settings.question: Will it treat active pimples?
settings.answer: This serum is focused on oil balance, texture, and overall clarity. For active breakouts, pair it with a targeted acne treatment or speak with our consultation team for a routine fit.

settings.question: What are the key actives?
settings.answer: Encapsulated niacinamide 5%, Sepicontrol™ A5, PDRN, Pentavitin™, and panthenol — supported by calming botanicals. Full ingredient information is listed on the product packaging and Shopify product details.

settings.question: Does it contain fragrance?
settings.answer: No added fragrance. The formula prioritises actives and comfort for acne-prone routines.

settings.question: Do I still need a moisturiser?
settings.answer: Yes. Seal the serum with a moisturiser suited to oily or combination skin so hydration stays balanced and the barrier stays supported.

settings.question: Is Project Skin cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes. Project Skin is committed to cruelty-free product development.
